title: Unused Rent and the Change of Size: Credit Terms for Safe Deposit Boxes
content:
When a lease of Safe Deposit Boxes ends, or when a lessee moves to another size, the terms below decide whether rent already paid is given back and what the move itself costs. Each stands the same for all six sizes.

| Term | Value, all sizes |
| --- | --- |
| Unused whole months of paid rent refunded on surrender | yes |
| Rent for the first rental year refundable on surrender | no |
| Unused whole months of rent credited when moving to another size | yes |
| Charge to move to another box size | $0.00 |

Restated: for a 3x5 Safe Deposit Box as much as for a 10x20 Safe Deposit Box, unused whole months of paid rent are given back both where the box is surrendered and where the lessee moves to another size; the single entry in this table that withholds a credit is the one covering the first rental year, whose rent is not refundable on surrender; and the move between sizes is itself free of charge, the figure being $0.00.

The two crediting entries answer two different events. One is engaged when the lease ends and the box is given up; the other when the lease continues and only the size changes. The charge of $0.00 attaches to the second of those events alone.
